lighthouse.identification: Alcatraz Lighthouse, not the separate water tower
lighthouse.position: US Coast Guard LNM 11-45-2024 rounded 37.82623 N, 122.42214 W, projected to EPSG:7131 x=77.7924, z=-11.3810; metre-scale approximate location
lighthouse.dimensions: 1910 station inventory: 13 ft 9 in base, 10 ft 8 in parapet, 90 ft 2.25 in base to ventilator ball; modeled as 4.191 m, 3.2512 m, and 27.48915 m. Square base to tapered octagonal shaft.
lighthouse.height_uncertainty: NPS calls the structure 95 ft, while USCG lists 84 ft. Their reference points may differ; do not claim a precise surveyed height. The 2023 unclassified maximum-surface grid peaks 69.73 m NAVD88 at x78,z-11, about 28.75 m above modeled bare-earth center, possibly including equipment.
lighthouse.modeled_details: Lantern piers, gallery, rail, windows and rotation are visual interpretations of an NPS photo, not measured plans; no interior. The former attached keeper quarters are not yet modeled.

warden_house.status: Photo-informed approximate present-day roofless ruin, not the intact 1934–1963 prison-era residence; burned in 1970.
warden_house.position: Approximate mapped center x97.158,z-21.376. Center is not a survey; photographic object coordinates differ by many metres.
warden_house.limitations: 20 by 12 m footprint, orientation, wall openings, breach, chimney and height are inferred visual blockout proportions, not measured and not a 1962 reconstruction. Other real structures may be absent.
